title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui actions rule names the selection key a bulk body receives
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35647
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照着界面技能写「批量操作」的作者,以前会写出一个读不到所选记录的按钮;现在技能教的是真正能拿到所选记录的写法。「新标签页打开」的示例也改成了能取到当前记录的写法。
- 为什么做:属于「对外发布的技能包教的内容要和运行时一致」这条线,替按技能生成应用的作者和 AI 解决「按钮点了显示成功、实际一条都没处理」的问题。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字、示例和一条评测用例,不动运行时;写错的话作者拿到的仍是一段错误示例,直接回退这个 PR 即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (published catalog), three passages, paid in place:

- **`list_toolbar` row.** It said a bulk action receives `input.selectedIds`. No path delivers that key, and a `list_toolbar` button's body is not handed the selection at all. The row now says so.
- **Bulk bullet.** Now names both list-view wirings and what each delivers: a name in `bulkActions` runs the action once per ticked row (`recordId`); a `bulkActionDefs` entry with `operation: 'custom'` and `execution: 'aggregate'` runs it once with the ids in `params._selectedIds` (a body's `input._selectedIds`).
- **`AddToCampaignAction` example.** Declares `execution: 'aggregate'`, drops the `list_toolbar` placement (the list view places a bulk action by name), and loops over `input._selectedIds`. The `Array.isArray` guard, the `campaignId` alias and the `return { count }` line are deleted to pay for the new text.
- **`PrintA3Action` example** (the fold row on the card, the closed card "new-tab example uses a hole the spec does not list, on a location with no current record"). `target` used a `record.id` hole; the runner substitutes only the `param` and `ctx` scopes. It now uses the `ctx.recordId` hole and sits on `record_header`, which has a record.

Changeset: `.changeset/35647-ui-bulk-selected-ids.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch.

**Round 2** (one new commit, head `d1e939d63f`, on top of `b239a9875f`):

- S1: the changeset sentence now names the two wirings apart. Under `bulkActions` the body runs once per ticked row with `recordId`; only a `bulkActionDefs` entry with `operation: 'custom', execution: 'aggregate'` hands the body `input._selectedIds`.
- S2: removed the refusal clause (contract record 7062828763).
- N1: the `list_toolbar` row and eval case 3's `expected_output` now read "its body gets no `_selectedIds`" in place of "never gets the selection".

<details><summary>Trace on origin/main 7ba22bb6ee: what a bulk handler receives</summary>

- Spec: `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts:87` lists `_selectedIds` in `ACTION_PARAM_BUILTIN_KEYS`; `:112` says an aggregate dispatch injects it; `:160-165` builds the near-miss hint for `selectedIds`.
- Renderer, aggregate: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2604-2606` dispatches once with `params: { ...params, _selectedIds: ids }`. Only a `bulkActionDefs` entry with `execution: 'aggregate'` reaches it (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts:454-468`); a bare name in `bulkActions` is promoted to one dispatch per row.
- Renderer, toolbar button: `ui/packages/core/src/actions/serverActionHandler.ts:222-232`. With no `_selectedIds` in the bag, one ticked row becomes `recordId`, several ticked rows are refused ("select exactly one row"), none sends no record. No array of ids is sent.
- Server: `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts:1648` sets a body's `input` to the action context's `params`, so the key is `input._selectedIds`.
- r1 trace moved off GitHub (area file).
- URL holes: `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:3189-3191` builds the scope map from `param` and `ctx` (plus `result` on the post-success hop); `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1400-1405` lists the same two families and names `ctx.recordId`.

</details>

## Evals

`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 3 (Convert plus bulk "Add to campaign"). It pinned the wrong teaching: `must_contain` held `list_toolbar` and `selectedIds`, and the expected answer read `input.selectedIds`.

- `expected_output`: the bulk action declares `execution: 'aggregate'`, is placed by the lead list view's `bulkActionDefs` entry, and its body reads `input._selectedIds`.
- `must_contain`: `list_toolbar` and `selectedIds` are replaced by `bulkActionDefs`, `aggregate` and `_selectedIds`.
- `must_not_contain`: adds `input.selectedIds`. No forbidden token occurs in the case's own `expected_output` (checked by script over every case in the file: 0 hits).

No eval round was run (a round is the eval seat's). The prompt is unchanged; both token lists changed, so earlier records of this case are set apart on a regrade.

No ablation: the diff changes prose, an example and an eval fixture, no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's ask was to name the key delivered to a `list_toolbar` bulk handler. Measured answer: a `list_toolbar` placement delivers no selection; the selection key `_selectedIds` arrives only through the list view's aggregate wiring. The text teaches that, which is wider than swapping one spelling.
- The fold record on the card lists the new-tab example as a row of this card; it is fixed here in place (two lines, zero net lines). The dispatch order named only the selection key, so this is flagged for the seat.
- A `type: 'url'` action on `list_toolbar` can still carry the selection through the runner's `ctx.selection.ids` hole (`ActionRunner.ts:3128-3133`). The spec's `target` description does not list that hole, so the skill does not teach it. Noted, not filed.
- The example action now carries no `locations`; the list view naming it is its placement (`packages/lint/src/validate-action-locations.ts`, which counts `bulkActionDefs` names).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, the bulk bullet under "Visibility, Disable & Feedback": the one sentence that now carries the wiring contract.
2. Same file, `AddToCampaignAction`: `execution: 'aggregate'` in place of `locations`.
3. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 3 token lists.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `rules/actions.md is 3700 tokens (ceiling 3711; headroom 11)` and exits 0.
